pages.text: $(4)Akaishi Hunting Ring$(0) (ring slot, 100k buffer): $(4)15%$(0) chance per kill to drop 1 Akaishi Crystal straight into your inventory — $(bold)no energy used$(0).

$(4)Akaishi Gathering Bracelet$(0) (hands slot, 100k buffer): $(4)5%$(0) chance per block mined to drop 1 Akaishi Crystal — also free.$(br2)One farms mobs, the other farms mining. Wear them and you carry a crystal dispenser everywhere.
Shared mechanics and the slot map live in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; the crystals they drop feed the refining line of $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystals & Essence$(/l).
